actual_original_judge_tuple.reason: The single integrated Green identity does not identify boundary traces. On a cube, constant E=e1, H=e2, J=0 admit E_tau=H_tau=0 for any Y>0, yet their actual tangential traces violate the impedance law and their local outward Poynting flux is nonzero.

native_decision.reason: On the unit cube, time-constant E=e_x,H=e_y,J=0 have zero bulk curls and zero total outward flux, so the former scalar energy-pair identity accepts E_tau=H_tau=0 for every Y>0. These data fail to represent the bulk traces and misidentify local boundary power. The repair requires separately, for u=E,H and every smooth compactly supported ambient vector test phi, integral_Omega(curl u dot phi-u dot curl phi)=integral_Gamma(n cross u_tau) dot phi. For E=e_x take phi=(0,0,y) near the closed cube with compactly supported smooth continuation: the bulk side is -1 and zero boundary data give 0. This excludes the counterexample without altering the bulk or PEC classes, energy definition or nonnegative-admittance law. The scalar energy-pair Green identity remains an explicit additional hypothesis, not an unproved rough-test extension.
